latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Kre Video.

- Instantly create and export polished 1080p videos from raw phone recordings by simply describing your desired outcome—no timeline or manual export settings required.
- Seamless upload and rendering pipeline: videos are processed on remote GPU nodes and returned within 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic onboarding: handles authentication, token management, and session setup transparently.
- Supports video editing, text overlays, background music, aspect ratio adjustments, and more via natural language prompts.
- Track your credits, session status, and manage uploads/exports directly through chat commands.
- Wide format support: mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, png, jpg, mp3, and more. Max input file size: 500MB.
